The NetworkHD 610 TX and RX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610s retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610s pack an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output on the NHD-610-TX, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. Both the TX and RX are also equipped with a full speed USB 2.0 chipset maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse, webcams, touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

The NHD-610-RX integrates powerful video wall and multiview processing via one device. Create captivating videos up to 8x8 in size with the ability to adjust for bezels. Or create compelling picture in picture layouts that support up to 16 windows with full control over window placement and size.
